hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$file" ] && pnpm exec prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.env(\..*)?$'; then echo 'Blocked: .env files must not be edited directly'; exit 2; fi
